label: General business or other organisation
summary: No unsubstantiated superlative or absolute guarantee claims
Professional terminology free of vague corporate buzzwords
tone_principles: Clear, direct, honest, and respectful. Avoid hyperbolic claims or pressure tactics.
writing_style: Active voice, concise sentences, and plain language suitable for general audiences.
messaging_principles: State features and terms accurately without concealed restrictions.
do_examples: We provide dependable customer support during business hours.
Our team resolves most customer requests within one business day.
dont_examples: We are the #1 company in the universe with 100% risk-free guarantees!
Sign up immediately or your competitors will crush you!

rules.title: Substantiate Promotional & Absolute Claims
rules.description: General communications must not use unsubstantiated absolute claims or hyperbolic promises.

suggested_replacements.100% risk-free: backed by our standard satisfaction policy

rules.do_example: Our services follow established quality benchmarks.
rules.dont_example: We guarantee 100% risk-free outcomes for all clients.

rules.title: Avoid High-Pressure or Alarmist Phrasing
rules.description: Do not use coercive urgency or panic-inducing expressions to prompt reader action.
rules.do_example: Review available options before the open registration deadline.
rules.dont_example: Act now or suffer the consequences of waiting!

terminology.notes: Replace dense jargon with clear, direct wording.
